commits.title: fix: preserve power-expander safety with hole-clearance pin (#2884)
Add Pipeline 9 TI EVM routing repros (#2889)

findings: Official changes include power-expander hole-clearance safety, an optimized tiny-hypergraph pin, and preservation of terminal route connectivity.
No direct TopologyMergingSolver source change appears in this release diff.
No stock/silkscreen/supplier-orientation fix is claimed from these router changes.

Installed Pipeline9 constructor places topologyMergingSolver before nodeDimensionSubdivisionSolver. The tested maxNodeDimension/maxNodeRatio settings are applied by the latter, after the stalled stage.
TopologyMergingSolver has no tiny-hypergraph import in the installed source. The newer optimized tiny-hypergraph pin is not a demonstrated repair for this stage.
No supported constructor switch for bypassing TopologyMergingSolver was found. Routing clearances and circuit validation were not changed.
decision: Pinned dependencies retained during these reproducible candidate jobs; newer package is not represented as installed or qualified.
